cards.title: War: latest news. Putin: Russia ready to mediate in the Middle East conflict
cards.titleEn: War: latest news. Putin: Russia ready to mediate in the Middle East conflict
cards.summary: Overnight, the IDF carried out several operations across the West Bank, arresting and questioning dozens of wanted suspects accused of involvement in terrorist activities and incitement to hatred, including expressing support for Hamas in relation to 7 October 2023 Russia is ready to support mediation efforts regarding the conflict in the Middle East: this was stated by the Russian President, Vladimir Putin, during a telephone conversation with his Iranian counterpart, Masoud Pezeshkian. During the conversation, the Russian leader and Pezeshkian discussed the “positive and expanding trajectory of relations” between the two countries, emphasising the need to further deepen ties, according to the Iranian news agency IRNA. With regard to the war, Putin “referred to the efforts of certain countries aimed at mediating and helping to reduce tensions, stating that Russia supports them”, the agency added; the Russian President assured that “Moscow is ready to play a role and provide assistance in this regard”. The memorial service for the victims of the Nova Music Festival on 7 October 2023
